Messages.Author: Bogus McBogus
Messages.Body:
Hi LSJ,

Nice job on the Bloodlines expansion.

Quick question about Clotho's gift (superior version)...
"Once during your minion phase, this vampire can burn 1 blood to untap"

Is the Clotho's gift ability to untap cumulative?
(i.e. can I get 2 clotho's gifts and untap twice?)

is Clotho's gift cumulative with "Nu, The Pillar's" special ability?
is Clotho's gift cumulative with Homunculus?

Please answer soon my friend, there's a tourney this weekend.
Thanks very much.

Messages.Author: Reyda
Messages.Body:
"Bogus McBogus" <bmcb...@hotmail.com> wrote in message
news:fb2f2f37.0201...@posting.google.com...

> Hi LSJ,
>
> Nice job on the Bloodlines expansion.
>
> Quick question about Clotho's gift (superior version)...
> "Once during your minion phase, this vampire can burn 1 blood to untap"
>
> Is the Clotho's gift ability to untap cumulative?
> (i.e. can I get 2 clotho's gifts and untap twice?)

Yes you can have two clotho s gift. nothing states that there is a
limitation of 1 clotho s gift per vampire.

> is Clotho's gift cumulative with "Nu, The Pillar's" special ability?
> is Clotho's gift cumulative with Homunculus?

yes. Everything is cumulative.
But however, due to the non repeat action floor rule, maybe it's not worth
spending so much blood to untap.
If you can build a deck with a lot of different action cards, then it may be
perfect =)
just let us know ;)

> Please answer soon my friend, there's a tourney this weekend.
> Thanks very much.

good luck.
